training_recipe: agents/Krischo/scripts/*: parametric rule-based expert found by search and league play against smarter opponents (krischo_optimize.py, krischo_league.py), distilled into a RecurrentPPO MlpLstmPolicy by behaviour cloning + 3 DAgger rounds, then 280k steps of RecurrentPPO fine-tuning on profit against the league (krischo_rl.py); observation scale folded into the LSTM input weights, six-seat matches, expansion masking
